descriptor.anonymous: Two young founders, a man and a woman, at a kitchen table late at night. Neither is a canon character.
descriptor.scene: Two young founders fill the middle of the frame from the waist up, sitting side by side at a small kitchen table at night, lit by one laptop between them, watching a line climb on its soft unreadable screen with equal parts terror and joy. Through the dark kitchen window behind them, impossibly far away, glows a vast warehouse of server racks receding in ordered rows, somebody else's building humming through the night for them. Dishes in the sink, cold tea, one hanging bulb.
negatives: the server warehouse reading as neon or sci-fi; it is warm distant industrial light
descriptor._caption: Then came a strange one. You could rent computers by the hour, the way you rent a room for the night. A weekend project could survive its own success. Two people could carry what used to take a building.
